result.keywords: This paper presents a fictional study of nocturnal kite lanterns used in coastal festivals, describing handcrafted paper frames, salt-tolerant dyes, and wave-synchronized lighting patterns. The work focuses on cultural design methods, material aging under sea mist, and community choreography rather than technical optimization. A small archival survey of harbor ceremonies and artisan interviews is included to illustrate seasonal symbolism, fabrication practices, and visual motifs.
result.title: Glow Harbor of Paper Kites.
